Name: JojaPop - Labubu Furniture
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]The Labubu craze has hit Pelican Town! These adorable gremlins can be placed in your home or around town to decorate anywhere that needs a spot of cute mischief. It won't be that easy to collect them though - you'll have to hope that the spirits are smiling on you as you buy and open blind boxes from Joja Pop, JojaMart's premier blind box reseller!

This mod adds 32 new decor furniture items that can be acquired through blind boxes purchased at a new vending machine in JojaMart or the movie theatre. One of four box sets is available each week - to open them, you'll need to buy a special unboxing table, also available via the vending machine (don't worry, they're cheap and quick!), then click on the table with your blind box. 

Which Labubu you get is up to luck! Each set contains 8 pieces: 3 common, 3 uncommon, 1 rare, and 1 ultra-rare. And if you [i]really[/i] can't find that one rare or ultra-rare Labubu that you're missing, try checking the travelling merchant's stock - she just might have the one you're looking for if you're willing to pay the extra price...

To see the sets available, click the spoilers below:
